name: El Dorado County, CA
findings: El Dorado County has 583 nonprofit organizations. 252 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 193 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, El Dorado County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 38 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 38 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in El Dorado County list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 74% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?
